promise: Deliver 100 million COVID-19 vaccine doses in the first 100 days
description: Biden announced the 100-million-shot goal on December 8, 2020. His administration reported reaching it on March 19, 2021, ahead of the deadline, before increasing the target to 200 million.
evidence: March 25 transcript says the original goal was reached by day 58.

review.note: 100 million reached March 19, day 58, not April 21/day 92 (later 200-million milestone). Normalize first-100-days due date convention separately.
